source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Λέων εν Μεθώνη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and adds where that day comes from: his honour lapsed about 1600 and after more than four hundred years the metropolitan of Messenia, Chrysostom III, restored his memory on 12 May. **No year of his own is printed** — the only dates on the page belong to Methone's role as a staging post from the fourth century, to the twelfth-century bishop Nicholas who took up his relics, and to the lapse about 1600 — so there is **no `dates` object**. **He is none of the corpus's twelve Leos**: none of them is a Calabrian pilgrim buried on the beach at Methone.
